status_summary: The FY2026 budget request proposed cutting roughly 308 million dollars from the Essential Air Service program, as discussed at a Senate appropriations subcommittee hearing on 2025-05-15. Congress did not adopt the cut: the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026 (H.R. 7148), which became Public Law 119-75 on 2026-02-03, provides 513.6 million dollars for the program per the Senate Appropriations Committee and DOT's FY2027 budget estimates. The FY2027 request asks 142.0 million dollars, 371.6 million below the FY2026 enacted level, with a legislative proposal to control program costs, but does not propose ending the program. The House Appropriations Committee reported its FY2027 bill (H.R. 9170) on 2026-06-03 with about 538 million dollars, no Senate bill had been proposed as of 2026-09-03, and a continuing resolution signed 2026-09-02 generally funds the account at FY2026 rates through 2026-12-11.

timeline.event: A Senate appropriations hearing covered the proposed $308 million cut to the program, and the Secretary said DOT would seek efficiencies.
